headline: TOR @ NYY matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TOR 3.76 at NYY 4.13, with a projected total of 7.88. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TOR: TOR moved +0.08 runs while NYY moved -0.28, changing the projected margin by +0.36 runs. NRFI probability rose +5.6%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Cam Schlittler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Daulton Varsho, Jesús Sánchez, Jazz Chisholm Jr., based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Austin Wells, Ryan McMahon because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
